svg.title: FX1 Ecosystem: Utility, Token Flow and Membership
svg.desc: A guided three-panel introduction to how fan activity improves FX1 products, how $FXI works, and how participation unlocks Arena access.
svg.text: FX1
HOW THE FX1 ECOSYSTEM WORKS
For more details, click FULL DETAILS in any panel.
THE CORE LOOP
Fan gameplay and AI training are one activity.
Fans play, label live sport and power better FX1 products.

g.text: PLAY Predictions, battles, trivia, creator challenges
EARN Shots through participation and AI tasks

svg.text: MOTIONAI LEARN
Structured labeling and validation tasks train FX1 AI.
Fan participation → better MotionAI data → better products
→ commercial revenue → a stronger Arena.
REAL COMMERCIAL BUSINESS
REVENUE → TREASURY
A defined share of net business revenue funds
buybacks, jackpots and ecosystem programs.
Sponsors pay for engagement • Enterprises for data
• Rights holders for tools — not trading alone.
One activity. Fan engagement and AI training.
HOW $FXI WORKS
One currency powers participation inside Arena.
REQUIRED FOR
Marketplace purchases • jackpot entries • premium tiers
Heritage benefits. Fixed supply; demand follows usage.
THREE WAYS TO GET $FXI
CRYPTO STAYS UNDER THE PRODUCT
Fans see Shots, available/locked $FXI, level and Heritage.
Custody holds assets; Arena keeps the ledger.
Ethereum is mainly for external transfers and settlement.
Daily actions stay off-chain; custody covers gas.
MARKETPLACE ECONOMICS
2% fee goes to the Arena Reserve — not a buyback;
FX1 already owns received tokens.
Vendor costs are settled separately, typically in fiat,
so a purchase does not automatically sell its $FXI.
Cash, margins, terms, partners, inventory and periodic
treasury rebalancing manage working capital at scale.
HOLD, LOCK & BUILD
Membership grows with your involvement.
HOLD FOR MORE THAN SPENDING
Early marketplace access • exclusive inventory
Premium MotionAI data • member pricing • ticket priority
Premium content • creator tools • partner benefits
LOCK: 30 DAYS • 90 DAYS • FULL SEASON
You still own $FXI, but cannot spend or withdraw it
during the term. No APY or yield product.
More benefits can retain tokens and reduce sell pressure.
OG / HERITAGE: THREE LAYERS
Permanent OG recognition + current balance + FXI Lock.
OG status stays forever; balance and lock add active perks.
Badge • first access • reserved drops • OG merchandise
Priority tickets • premium content • events • community
Access: OG/Heritage → holders → general Arena.
ARENA LEVELS & ROLLOUT
Arena → Pro → Elite → Heritage + Active.
Levels can reflect sustained/average balance, lock,
participation and Heritage status.
BUILT IN PARALLEL
Telegram + Heritage → jackpot → private → public launch.
Community, rewards and business lines grow together.
WHY THE MODEL WORKS
Real demand from users, sponsors, partners and FX1's
commercial business — not token trading alone.
We can't control price; we can build reasons to use $FXI.
